source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Broadly ovate, crenate blades; often yellow/red fall color
morphology_documented.flowers: Spring blooms, about 2–2.5 cm across, inflorescences glabrous; 2(–3) styles (genus key)
morphology_documented.fruit: Usually globose pome about 1 cm across (genus key)
morphology_documented.habitat: Cultivated and escaping along creeks and disturbed sites

source_scope_note: Species-level and key-level traits distinguished; modern secondary traits stay attributed to their own sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historical flora cites Bradford and Aristocrat cultivars and naturalization in TX; introduced from China
Do not recommend any cultivar as project native
preservation: Additive research only, species JSON and photo/attribution/gallery assets unchanged
